name: Umbra
description: A void weapon that is already strong the moment you hold it and then climbs in a straight, unbroken line — no spike, no collapse in its power, only a steadily deepening absence. Features Gravity Well [Z] and Erasure [X].

phases.name: Phase 1: Null
phases.effects: The blade takes light but gives nothing back — a dark core under a thin pale rim. Heavy for its size. Base 900 DMG and 12,000 HP.

phases.name: Phase 2: Dusk
phases.effects: The rim thickens and the dark inside the blade deepens, pulling the light out of the air around it. Base 2,100 DMG and 30,000 HP.
phases.notification: The light is not staying around you.

phases.name: Phase 3: Shade
phases.effects: Distortion gathers along the edge: a faint field that eats colour from anything standing near it. Base 4,800 DMG and 70,000 HP.
phases.notification: You can see it working. Everything looks duller.

phases.name: Phase 4: Veil
phases.effects: A veil of void trails the blade, dimming everything it passes over and leaving a dark wake behind every swing. Base 11,000 DMG and 160,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not swinging through the air. It is swinging through what the air used to be.

phases.name: Phase 5: Hollow
phases.effects: The blade is genuinely empty inside — a shell of void with nothing in it, and loose matter drifts toward the edge and does not come back. Base 25,000 DMG and 360,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is hollow. It still cuts. Nothing about that makes sense.

phases.name: Phase 6: Grasp
phases.effects: The emptiness has a pull now: debris, dust and light all lean toward the blade and vanish at the edge. Base 56,000 DMG and 800,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is reaching for things. It does not need you to aim it.

phases.name: Phase 7: Unmaking
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The pull turns inward and eats its own edge: a blunt grey blade with a hairline of violet left along the spine. Unlocks Gravity Well [Z] — rips every enemy within 3x your swing range toward you and deals 180% damage. Base 15 DMG and 150 HP.
phases.notification: ...It took itself apart. ...And now it wants to take something else.

phases.name: Phase 8: Abyss
phases.effects: The blade re-forms around the pull and is deeper than it was: a black core ringed in violet, with matter visibly bending into it. Base 126,000 DMG and 1,750,000 HP.
phases.notification: It put itself back together with something extra.

phases.name: Phase 9: Oblivion
phases.effects: A vertical tear in the world: the void core is permanent and the violet rim burns brighter the more it consumes. Base 285,000 DMG and 3,800,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not a weapon with a void in it. It is a void with a handle.

phases.name: Phase 10: Event Horizon
phases.effects: The pull has a boundary now: a hard ring beyond which nothing returns, drawn in bent violet light around the blade. Base 640,000 DMG and 8,200,000 HP.
phases.notification: There is a line around it. Do not be on the wrong side.

phases.name: Phase 11: Singularity
phases.effects: Everything collapses to a single point: a white-hot violet knot with the whole blade bending around it and light spiralling inward. Base 1,440,000 DMG and 17,500,000 HP.
phases.notification: It has stopped being a hole. It is a point, and it is very heavy.

phases.name: Phase 12: Unravelling
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The singularity comes apart along its own seams: a scarred black blade with violet light leaking through the cracks, and far more behind the cracks than before. Unlocks Erasure [X] — instantly erases every enemy below 25% HP within 3x your swing range, and deals 200% damage to those above it. Base 330,000 DMG and 690,000 HP.
phases.notification: ...Undone. Again. ...Fine. Then let it undo theirs.

phases.name: Phase 13: Voidwake
phases.effects: The blade drags a wake of absent space behind it, and anything caught in that wake keeps falling into it after the swing has passed. Base 1,950,000 DMG and 24,000,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is leaving holes behind and they are not closing.

phases.name: Phase 14: Erebus
phases.effects: Primordial dark given an edge: the blade no longer needs a void inside it because everything around it is already becoming one. Base 2,600,000 DMG and 32,000,000 HP.
phases.notification: This is older than the dark you are used to.

phases.name: Phase 15: Absolute Void
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: ABSOLUTE VOID. Umbra has stopped containing an absence and started being one — there is simply no longer a version of the world where this blade is not here. Base 3,400,000 DMG, 42,000,000 HP and 92 SPD. Cease.
phases.notification: Nothing was taken. Nothing was destroyed. There was just never anything there.
